_note: US dollars per million tokens, keyed by the canonical model spec a run records (<provider>/<model>; a bare claude-<id> key is read as anthropic/<id>). A model with no entry has costUsd null. Claude rates are Anthropic's list prices (cache write at 1.25x and cache read at 0.1x of input where not stated). A model with a price but no cache rates is priced at the input rate for cached tokens. Fireworks publishes rates on its pricing page, not in its API: add fireworks/<model> entries as { input, output, cacheRead }.
